title: Chapter 279: Zerg'S Battlefield Adaptability
content:
Chapter 279: Zerg'S Battlefield Adaptability

The number of five hundred four-star Zerg destroyers is still too small to affect the large-scale battlefield magic that the alien mages continue to cast.

The enhanced version of the falling stars battlefield magic above the main formation of the Zerg main combat unit lasted for nearly a minute, blasting a large area of the ground into densely packed holes like the surface of the moon.

If the Zerg army were to withstand such a powerful battlefield magic, the loss would be unimaginable!

This battlefield gift carefully prepared for the Zerg army was easily cracked by the Zerg army. The mood of the aliens at this moment can be imagined.

A group of Zerg explosive mosquitoes in the Zerg air force flew out of the Zerg flying dragon group and flew at high speed towards the alien mages and the mysterious chariot.

Wu Qing was ready to try other methods to attack the alien mages, and the Zerg explosive mosquitoes were the best choice now.

The five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes accelerated in a dive, as fast as lightning, and could not be intercepted at all.

"Boom boom!"

A group of five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes exploded with great power, sweeping away a large number of buildings and personnel in the Tianwai Human City 996.

As expected by Wu Qing, the mysterious chariot provided a strong defense for nearly 10,000 Tianwai Human Mage Powerfuls.

A small protective shield that was enough to cover all the Tianwai Human Mage Powerfuls rose up, and the attack of the five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes did not shake its defense.

The five hundred four-star Zerg destroyers in the Zerg flying dragon group continued to upgrade to five stars.

The army of Tianwai Human City 996 has rushed out of the city wall and rushed into the area where the Zerg puppies are located.

A large number of Zerg puppies drilled out from the ground and launched a desperate attack on the powerful Tianwai Human Army.

The Zerg puppies in the surrounding areas also rushed in this direction, besieging and blocking the Tianwai Human Army that rushed out of the city.

The Zerg destroyers that had burrowed underground came out just as the magic of the Falling Stars battlefield ended. They launched an attack on the broken positions and provided long-range support to the Zerg puppies.

Some pits had little impact on the Zerg army's operations.

In the first Zerg sub-base underground in the 66th city, a large group of Zerg explosive mosquitoes and a thousand three-star Zerg queens hatched. They formed a team and were flying towards the battlefield of the 996th city at a very high speed.

The combat power of the Zerg puppies was still quite different from that of the alien army. They relied entirely on their advantage in numbers to block the charge of the alien army.

The alien army used cavalry units to break through, followed up with melee infantry to suppress, and used long-range attack crossbowmen, magic arms and siege equipment in the city to provide long-range firepower support, causing heavy losses to the Zerg puppies.

It was not until the firepower support of the Zerg destroyers arrived that the blocking pressure of the Zerg puppies was slightly relieved.

"Boom boom...!"

The Zerg Destroyer's attack landed on the various arms of the charging alien army, disrupting their offensive rhythm and greatly reducing the pressure on the Zerg Puppies.

Five hundred four-star Zerg Queens completed the upgrade and their strength increased to five stars. They immediately launched a spawning attack on the alien mages who were preparing battlefield magic.

Another five hundred alien mages will be killed in one blow!

There are a total of one thousand Zerg Queens, of which the five hundred three-star Zerg Queens have consumed a lot of resources to upgrade twice, and now all of them have increased their strength to five stars.

These Zerg Queens, using the ability to restore their status after upgrading, launched a total of two thousand spawning attacks, killing nearly two thousand alien mages.

This number accounts for nearly one-fifth of the tens of thousands of alien mages who can't tell the real from the fake, but it still does not affect the normal casting of the alien mages.

Although the aliens paid a lot of price and lost many precious mages, their idea of cracking the Zerg Queen's one-hit-kill attack was very effective.

Unfortunately, the aliens believed that the Starfall battlefield magic, which was the most powerful against the Zerg army, lost its due effect because of the Zerg army's ability to drill into the ground, making the loss of mages by the aliens seem a bit unworthy.

Wu Qing couldn't tell what the second battlefield magic prepared by the alien mages was. He could only let the Zerg destroyers who needed to participate in the battle drill out of the ground to fight first, and let other Zerg troops who didn't need to fight temporarily stay underground.

The powerful and large battlefield magic was enough to change the outcome of a war. It would definitely not be easy to use it, and there would be many restrictions.

Wu Qing didn't believe that the alien mages who lost one-fifth of their troops could continue to use large battlefield magic one after another.

Wu Qing was ready to continue to take on the second battlefield magic of the aliens.

The battlefield magic has a wide coverage and is extremely powerful, but it is not very fast.

The Zerg army can adapt to the situation according to the characteristics of the second battlefield magic.

Wu Qing only needs to command the queen to command the Zerg. The Zerg is one, which is a huge command advantage and can respond to various emergencies quickly without any confusion.

Moreover, the Zerg does not rely on external objects, and its own adaptability and various resistances are very strong. As long as it is not another battlefield magic as powerful as the enhanced version of Starfall, the Zerg is not afraid.

The powerful version of the Stars Falling Battlefield magic just now must be a carefully prepared trump card of the Tianwai Human Race, specifically targeting the Zerg army. If it is to be used again, it is temporarily impossible to rely solely on the remaining powerful Magicians of the Tianwai Human Race.

Another five-star Zerg Explosive Mosquito flew out and rushed towards the human mage guarded by the mysterious chariot, continuing to test the defensive capabilities of the mysterious chariot.

More five-star Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes detonated themselves. In addition to blowing up more buildings and other personnel, they still failed to break through the defense of the mysterious tank.

The only Queen of the Zerg who could attack the powerful mage of the Tianwai Human Race, the spawning attack took time to recover, and she could only watch the second battlefield magic of the Tianwai Human Race being unleashed.

The rules of heaven and earth in the main formation area of the Zerg main battle unit have undergone some changes again!

This time the change does not come from the sky, but from the ground.

"Boom, boom, boom...!"

The whole earth was shaking, shaking violently, and a powerful force formed underground, like a prelude to a super earthquake.

The Zerg main combat units lurking underground, including the Zerg puppies lurking in the surrounding areas, all sensed this power and all dug upwards, trying to get out of the ground.

But this time the battlefield magic attack was very fast. Before a large number of Zerg troops could get out of the ground, the entire area was shattered by landslides, and a super terrible earthquake occurred!

There are cracks and abysses all over the ground. Under the ground, boulders are shifting and the soil is rolling, as if a big hand is holding the land.

If ordinary soldiers were hiding underground, they would have no chance of surviving such a major earthquake!

But the Zerg race is not an ordinary race. Wu Qing felt relieved when he saw that the Heavenly Outer Race was using magic aimed at the underground.

The Zerg's body structure and talent for burrowing into the ground are enough to allow them to protect themselves from this large-scale underground attack magic.

The battlefield magic power of the Tianwai Human Race was released in an instant. After a few seconds, the magic energy was exhausted, and the entire battlefield had completely changed.

The Zerg troops emerged from the ground one after another. Although they looked a little embarrassed and many suffered some injuries, their combat effectiveness was almost not affected.

"The vitality and adaptability of the Zerg are really strong, but the powerful battlefield magic of the Tianwai Terrans actually doesn't have much effect!"

"The outer human race is probably going crazy now, haha! The two super battlefield magics launched at such a price have almost no impact on the Zerg army!"

"There is nothing wrong with the decision-making of the Tianwai Terrans. I can only say that the Zergs have strong adaptability and adaptability. It is difficult for large-scale battlefield magic to cause much harm to the Zergs!"

"The Zerg race is indeed extraordinary. Even the elite troops of the major tribes will find it difficult to resist the two battlefield magics of the humans from outside the world!"

"Both the battlefield magic that attacks the ground and the underground is ineffective against the Zerg army. Now let's see how the Terrans will choose!"

"What else to choose? Can they continue to use large-scale battlefield magic?"

"It's really hard to say! The Tianwai Human Race must be fully prepared this time. It depends on whether the Zerg's countermeasures are effective!"

"..."

Observers from all forces in the local camp were surprised that the Zerg army could calmly deal with the two large-scale battlefield magics of the outer human race.

At the same time, he was also happy about the defeat of the Tianwai human race on the battlefield.

Wu Qing saw through the Zerg host that the remaining powerful mages from the Tianwai human race had stopped casting large-scale battlefield magic.

I don't know if it's because they discovered that large-scale battlefield magic has a limited impact on the Zerg army, or because those outsider human mages can only cast these two large-scale battlefield magics.

The Tianwai Human Race changed their strategy again. The mysterious chariot, pulled by a group of white horses, continued to move forward with the powerful Master of the Tianwai Human Race, and did not stop until the edge of the range of the Zerg Destroyer.

The Tianwai Terrans have clashed with the Zerg several times, and have roughly tested the ultimate range of the Zerg Destroyers. The Tianwai Terrans do not want the mysterious tanks to face the endless attacks of the Zerg Destroyers.

The powerful human mage from outside the world stayed in a position where the Zerg destroyers could not attack. Only the Zerg explosive mosquitoes could attack them.

From the perspective of the Tianwai Terrans, units like the Zerg Explosive Mosquito must not have many troops. The cost of a five-star unit's self-destruction attack is still a bit high.

Just like the Zerg's one-hit kill ability, it is also impossible to use it frequently.

The Tianwai human race is also using facts to prove that their conjecture is correct.
